target: SPX cash close on the specified session, not the day's high/low range
calibration_quantile: Order statistic ceil((n+1)*coverage), using only earlier sessions; no finite estimate if rank exceeds n.
notes: ATM Black lognormal approximation ignores volatility skew; option-implied bands are pricing distributions, not validated physical probabilities. Historical residual quantiles are a calibration heuristic for dependent financial time series, not a guarantee of conformal coverage. No OI, dealer-position signs, Gamma walls or arbitrary mean reversion are assumed. Existing historical sample has already been inspected. No trading or automatic scheduler.
